name: Armor of Light
body:
School abjuration [good, light]; Level sorcerer/wizard 4, white necromancer 4, witch 4

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range touch
Target creature touched
Duration 10 min./level
Saving Throw Will negates (harmless); Spell Resistance yes (harmless)

DESCRIPTION

The target is covered in an armor of pure light. The target gains a +4 deflection bonus to their AC. This AC bonus increases by +1 for every three levels above 7th, to a maximum of +8 at 19th level. This armor sheds light like a torch. The target also gains an additional +2 bonus to AC and to their saves against darkness, evil, and shadow effects. If the target is living, they also gain a +4 bonus on saves vs. channel negative energy, touch of corruption, or similar abilities.
